font_family.description: The primary font family name for the Khmer OS Content font.

default_family.description: The default fallback font family when Khmer OS Content is specified as a generic alias.

locale_code.description: The ISO 639 language code used to trigger locale-specific font matching rules.

test_family.description: The font family name tested in the match condition for locale-specific overrides.

edit_family.description: The font family name prepended to the font stack when the locale and test conditions are met.
